options.name: Standard Delivery
options.summary: Deliver case management workflows OOTB and exclude the resident self-service portal due to lack of accessibility evidence.
assumptions: The buying organization accepts deferring the resident self-service portal to a later phase.

scores.reason: Meets case management delivery requirements but omits the portal.
Offers limited social value without the self-service component.

options.name: Partner-assisted Portal Delivery
options.summary: Deliver case management workflows OOTB and partner with a local digital inclusion agency to build the resident self-service portal alternative.
assumptions: A qualified partner is available to deliver accessibility-compliant portal capabilities.

scores.reason: Addresses both case management and portal requirements through a specialised partner.
Brings additional social value by collaborating with local digital inclusion partners.

options.name: Exclude personal data processing from initial scope
options.summary: Exclude personal data processing from the current implementation until the data protection impact assessment can be completed.

scores.reason: Meets the data protection compliance requirement by relying on a specialized partner to handle the impact assessment.

risks.condition: Data migration is required to complete within a 48 hour maintenance window under REQ-301, while HAZ-001/UNCAPPED_LIABILITY places unlimited liability on the contractor for migration delays.
risks.event: The automated ETL migration pipeline under APP-301 hits unforeseen data corruptions or bottlenecks, exceeding the 48-hour window.
risks.effect: The contractor faces uncapped financial liability due to the breach of the migration window.
assumptions: The automated ETL migration pipeline can process all legacy data within 48 hours without manual intervention.
risks.trigger: A dry-run migration test exceeds 40 hours.
responses: Perform a full-scale dry run of the ETL pipeline before the go-live maintenance window.
Negotiate a liability cap for migration delays with the client.
risks.residual_exposure: Uncapped liability remains if the pipeline fails during the actual cutover.

open_questions.text: What is the total volume and schema complexity of the legacy data to be migrated within the 48-hour window?

risks.condition: REQ-302 mandates a 99.99% SLA for the third-party payment gateway integration, but APP-302 relies on a circuit breaker pattern without specifying the underlying provider's availability commitments.
risks.event: The third-party payment gateway experiences outages that cumulatively exceed the downtime allowed by a 99.99% SLA, and the circuit breaker trips.
risks.effect: The payment integration breaches the SLA, incurring liquidated damages as specified in the contract penalties.
assumptions: The third-party payment provider can achieve 99.99% uptime natively.
risks.trigger: The third-party payment provider's published historical availability falls below 99.99%.
responses: Negotiate an enterprise contract with the payment gateway provider including back-to-back SLA credits.
Implement a secondary fallback payment gateway.
risks.residual_exposure: Dependence on third-party vendor reliability despite architectural mitigations.

open_questions.text: What is the exact allowable downtime per month or year for the 99.99% SLA under the penalty terms?

risks.condition: The approach relies on a multi-region active-passive replica failover for REQ-303, but passive replicas require state synchronization and manual or automated DNS switching that can exceed 15 minutes.
risks.event: A disaster occurs, and the multi-region failover takes 25 minutes to complete due to replication lag.
risks.effect: Recovery Time Objective is breached, disrupting business continuity beyond the allowable 15-minute threshold.
assumptions: Active-passive replication lag will remain under 5 minutes during peak load.
risks.trigger: Failover drill takes longer than 10 minutes.
responses: Switch from active-passive to active-active multi-region replication.
Perform automated failover tests weekly to measure exact RTO.
risks.residual_exposure: A residual risk of transient DNS propagation delays affecting complete user cutover.

open_questions.text: Does the 15-minute failover requirement include complete DNS propagation time globally?
